name: default_10x6
description: Indoor 10 x 6 m navigation arena. Dimensions mirror Spencer's planar.py benchmark (LOW=[0,-3], HIGH=[10,3]) so trained PPO policies see a familiar workspace. All coordinates are in the DNS frame: +x forward, +y right, fixed altitude, fixed yaw.

arena._wall_height_note: 2.5 m, raised from 1.2 m. A 1.2 m parapet is not a credible boundary for a drone cruising at 1.0 m, and it left only 0.125 m of wall above the lidar plane -- so any airframe tilt beyond 6 deg sent the beams over the top and the sensor reported open space where a wall stood (results/lidar_attitude.json). 2.5 m keeps the walls in view for the full altitude and tilt envelope.

_mode_options: physical  - full quadcopter rigid-body physics with a cascaded autopilot
kinematic - LABELLED INTERFACE TEST ONLY: integrates the commanded velocity directly. Not a flight model.
none      - every sector reported as (0.0, False) = unobserved. Correct default until the sensor owner delivers processing.
lidar     - real Webots Lidar returns binned into 12 sectors by Spencer's navigation.pack_scan
geometric - GROUND TRUTH ray-cast from supervisor positions. Debug/reference only, not a sensor.
_mount_options: stabilised - ideal gimbal: the mount is counter-rotated each control tick so the scan plane stays horizontal. Makes the flat 12-sector contract true.
body_fixed - bolted to the airframe, so the scan plane tilts with it. MEASURABLY CORRUPTS the scan during manoeuvres (see docs/SENSOR_ATTITUDE.md); kept as the S7 independent variable.
sensing._beams_note: 720 beams over 360 deg = 0.5 deg spacing, 60 beams per 30 deg sector. Raised from 360 because beam pitch bounds the worst-case grazing error: a cylinder overlapping a sector boundary by less than one beam pitch can be missed by that sector entirely and read as clear-to-cap, even though the neighbouring sector still holds the return (results/lidar_attitude.json).

_mode_options: geometric - swept-segment test against obstacle discs and arena walls, matching planar.py. Keeps the contract identical to PPO training.
physical  - Webots contact points on the drone body
either    - logical OR of the two
